sources.entry: Spoolman - Keep track of your inventory of 3D-printer filament spools. MIT Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Spoolman is a self-hosted web service for tracking 3D-printer filament spool inventory and automatically updating spool weights from connected printing software.
summary.what_it_does: Spoolman acts as a central database for filament types, manufacturers, and individual spools. It integrates with Moonraker/Klipper front-ends and OctoPrint so spool weights update as printing progresses, and it handles updates from several printers at once. A built-in web client lets you create, edit, and delete filament data, search and filter inventory, add custom fields, and design and print QR-code labels. It offers a REST API and Websocket live updates, supports SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and CockroachDB, and can export metrics to Prometheus for usage history. The README also mentions a community filament database (SpoolmanDB) for adding spools, and an MCP server for managing inventory through AI assistants.
use_cases: automatically update filament weight after prints
print QR code labels for spools
monitor filament usage over time with Prometheus
connect Klipper or OctoPrint to a spool database
manage filament inventory through AI assistants
how_to_run: Follow the Installation page on the project's Wiki (the README does not include commands)
notable: Automatically updates spool weights from Moonraker/Klipper and OctoPrint during printing
Built-in web client with drag-and-drop spool cards, grouping, and custom fields
Label designer generating QR labels from spool, filament, or vendor fields
MCP server for managing inventory via AI assistants like Claude
Community filament database (SpoolmanDB) and translations into 18 languages via Weblate
caveats: README points to the Wiki for installation details rather than giving commands
A new web client is shipped alongside a legacy client; the README asks users to report problems and offers SPOOLMAN_LEGACY_CLIENT=TRUE as a fallback
Developed and maintained in the author's spare time (sponsorship requested)
